gap_ledger.note: run-encoded gap ledger: one class per distinct (reason, domain set, witness) tuple, with the hours it occurred at. Replaces the flat `gaps` and `domain_gap_outcomes` arrays, which cost 33.5 KB of manifest JSON per game hour. Expand it with the recorder_host gap_ledger module or the gap_ledger.py helper.

note: one encoded gap ledger and the rows it must expand to. Produced and asserted by recorder_host::gap_ledger's tests, consumed by scripts/test_gap_ledger.py, so the Rust and Python expanders cannot drift apart. Rows are sorted by their own serialization; `h4gp_hex` is absent because the ledger does not carry it.
